title: Persistent PlayCanvas boot failure recovery
surface: Primary and legacy route startup overlay and Retry action
behavior: Synchronous startup failures and rejected route imports replace the normal click-through loader with a persistent, accessible recovery message and actionable Retry button. Normal loader dismissal, first-frame readiness, the 4-second safety timer, delayed is-gone transition, legacy route, and boothold behavior remain intact outside recovery.
failure_mode: A boot failure may leave an invisible/blank game or a Retry overlay that can be dismissed by a pointer/key event, safety timeout, delayed transition callback, or PlayCanvas first-frame signal. Normal readiness may also hide the intentionally held boothold overlay.
fixtures: Synthetic boot DOM/controller; Playwright local route with one-shot PlayCanvas module request failure; desktop pointer and mobile touch browser contexts; legacy route.
steps: Run npm run smoke:boot-recovery with its local Vite and Playwright bootstrap.

Verify a failed dynamic import restores the error overlay after ordinary pointer dismissal and leaves it visible after key/pointer events, the 4-second timer, and the pending 450ms hide transition; confirm the first-frame hide callback is ignored after failure.
Use the desktop Retry button with a real pointer click and the touch Retry button with a real tap; verify a second route request and successful game-shell startup.
Run npm run test:legacy and verify ordinary route readiness/dismissal, plus the unit assertion that boothold remains visible after readiness hide but can still transition to failure recovery.
success_criteria: Synchronous startup exceptions and asynchronous import rejections enter recovery rather than leaving an unhandled blank route.
Once failed, the recovery overlay remains visible past the 4-second timeout, key/pointer input, stale delayed hide callback, and first-frame hide signal.

Retry is a semantic, keyboard-focusable button with a visible focus treatment and a real desktop/touch hit target; activating it reloads the document and permits a subsequent successful route request.
During ordinary non-failure loading, click-through and dismissal still work, the legacy route reaches its normal menu, and boothold remains visible when route readiness invokes hide.
A boot failure still overrides boothold and any prior normal dismissal, revealing recovery until Retry reloads.

tests.name_or_pattern: boot overlay lifecycle and boot attempt error handling
desktop pointer Retry and mobile touch Retry reload route after injected import failure
legacy route menu startup and normal boot overlay dismissal

notes: Specification only. Worktree test outcomes are recorded in the batch ledger. Browser smoke forces an asynchronous module request failure; synchronous throw is covered by the executable runBootAttempt unit test. No hosted or production claim is made.
